name: Meg Murphy
organization: Founding Advisor, Harvard HealthLab Accelerators; Founder, Blue42 Labs
title: storytelling expert and pitch coach
bio: Meg Murphy is a Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist and co-founder of Harvard HealthLab Accelerators, a social impact accelerator based at Harvard University. She is now one of the founders of Blue42 Labs, a global innovation ecosystem for emerging social entrepreneurs. Previously, Meg worked in strategic communications for leadership at Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. A former journalist, Meg has written for various newspapers and weeklies, including The Boston Globe, The Globe and Mail, The Village Voice, and NOW Magazine. She holds degrees from the University of Toronto and Columbia University’s Graduate School of Journalism.
